datasets.name: ALT (Asian Language Treebank) Test — All Pairs ben→eng
datasets.source: NICT (National Institute of Information and Communications Technology) / ALT Project
datasets.notes: Multi-way parallel evaluation corpus from the Asian Language Treebank (NICT). 13 languages (Bengali, English, Filipino, Hindi, Indonesian, Japanese, Khmer, Lao, Malay, Myanmar/Burmese, Thai, Vietnamese, Chinese), built from Wikinews articles and sentence-aligned across all languages. Champollion uses the official ALT-Standard TEST split (the 1,018 English sentences whose article URLs are listed in URL-test.txt); a few cells are absent where ALT never translated a sentence into a given language, so per-pair sizes vary slightly (1016-1018). Only the BARE PARALLEL corpus (CC-BY-4.0) is used — the per-language treebank annotation layers (CC-BY-NC-SA) are deliberately NOT ingested. Adds the SEA gap: Lao, Khmer, Burmese, Filipino, Malay.
datasets.attribution: NICT (National Institute of Information and Communications Technology) / ALT Project (CC-BY-4.0)

datasets.notes: Multi-way parallel evaluation corpus from the Asian Language Treebank (NICT). 13 languages (Bengali, English, Filipino, Hindi, Indonesian, Japanese, Khmer, Lao, Malay, Myanmar/Burmese, Thai, Vietnamese, Chinese), built from Wikinews articles and sentence-aligned across all languages. Champollion uses the official ALT-Standard TEST split (the 1,018 English sentences whose article URLs are listed in URL-test.txt); a few cells are absent where ALT never translated a sentence into a given language, so per-pair sizes vary slightly (1016-1018). Only the BARE PARALLEL corpus (CC-BY-4.0) is used — the per-language treebank annotation layers (CC-BY-NC-SA) are deliberately NOT ingested. Adds the SEA gap: Lao, Khmer, Burmese, Filipino, Malay.
datasets.attribution: NICT (National Institute of Information and Communications Technology) / ALT Project (CC-BY-4.0)

datasets.name: AmericasNLP 2021 — Open MT shared task (test) spa→aym
datasets.notes: AmericasNLP 2021 Shared Task on Open Machine Translation — the held-out test set for Spanish → Indigenous languages of the Americas (Aymara, Bribri, Asháninka, Guaraní, Wixarika, Hñähñu/Otomi, Quechua, Shipibo-Konibo, Rarámuri). Multi-parallel: one Spanish source (test_data/test.es) translated into each target (test_data/test.{lang}); each direction is scored es→xx (the shared-task direction). Nahuatl is excluded (mixed-variety macro code, no honest single-variety card). Fetched on demand from the task's GitHub repo at a pinned commit; Champollion never hosts the content. Domain 'conv' (general elicited sentences). Contamination HIGH — public since 2021, memorized — so scores are relative-comparison-only. License is UNSTATED upstream and aggregates heterogeneous per-language sources (incl. religious JW300 for Quechua), so the set is tagged non-commercial and is held by the license review of 2026-08-24 — mixed, partly unstated terms are never interpreted on the rights-holders' behalf; a direct local run by corpus id stays possible but can never rank.
datasets.quarantine_reason: License review 2026-08-24: HELD. No single upstream license; the set aggregates heterogeneous per-language corpora with distinct provenance (incl. religious-source JW300 for Quechua), and mixed or unstated terms are never interpreted on the rights-holders' behalf. Catalogued; excluded from the queue, contests, and ranking (DB trigger, migration 022); remote transmission refused (consent-required). A direct local run stays possible but its result can never rank. Clears per language as terms are stated, or by a recorded grant.

Nahuatl is excluded (mixed-variety macro code, no honest single-variety card). Fetched on demand from the task's GitHub repo at a pinned commit; Champollion never hosts the content. Domain 'conv' (general elicited sentences). Contamination HIGH — public since 2021, memorized — so scores are relative-comparison-only. License is UNSTATED upstream and aggregates heterogeneous per-language sources (incl. religious JW300 for Quechua), so the set is tagged non-commercial and is held by the license review of 2026-08-24 — mixed, partly unstated terms are never interpreted on the rights-holders' behalf; a direct local run by corpus id stays possible but can never rank.
datasets.quarantine_reason: License review 2026-08-24: HELD. No single upstream license; the set aggregates heterogeneous per-language corpora with distinct provenance (incl. religious-source JW300 for Quechua), and mixed or unstated terms are never interpreted on the rights-holders' behalf. Catalogued; excluded from the queue, contests, and ranking (DB trigger, migration 022); remote transmission refused (consent-required). A direct local run stays possible but its result can never rank. Clears per language as terms are stated, or by a recorded grant.

Both directions scored. Document-level context is preserved in order but not yet exploited by the harness (see card notes). Fetched on demand from the pinned commit; Champollion never hosts the content. Domain: conv (business dialogue). Contamination HIGH — public since 2020, in frontier-model crawls — so scores are relative-comparison-only. License CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (verified at the pin) → non-commercial lanes only; cleared by the license review of 2026-08-24 into the NC research lane: benchmarkable; never in a commercial, prize, or API lane; remote evaluation only over no-train channels.

Domain 'mixed': general short factual content across many topics; domainDistribution is an approximate placeholder over general-informational domains, pending a per-corpus classifier pass on the built corpus.

datasets.name: Turkic X-WMT Test — All Pairs aze→bak
datasets.notes: Multi-way parallel evaluation corpus from the Turkic Interlingua X-WMT test set (Mirzakhalov et al., 2021). 10 languages (Azerbaijani, Bashkir, English, Karakalpak, Kazakh, Kyrgyz, Russian, Sakha/Yakut, Turkish, Uzbek), every ordered pair present (90 directions), each direction 300–1000 sentences (size varies by direction). Non-English source directions (Turkic-Turkic, Turkic→Russian) are the least-contaminated and most valuable for low-resource Turkic MT. Adds Bashkir, Karakalpak, and Sakha. MIT licensed.

pin.basis: TIL X-WMT Azerbaijani is the Latin-script national standard — North Azerbaijani (azj); the only other member, South Azerbaijani (azb), is written in Arabic script.

datasets.name: WMT24++ Test — English → 55 targets eng→arb
datasets.notes: WMT24++ (Google/Unbabel) English→target MT evaluation, 55 language pairs / 47 languages including regional variants (fr-CA/fr-FR, pt-BR/pt-PT, es-MX, ar-EG/ar-SA, sw-KE/sw-TZ, zh-CN/zh-TW) plus EU and Indic languages. Uses the human POST-EDIT 'target' field (not the raw 'original_target' MT) and drops every is_bad_source row (including the canary). English-source only; regional variants that share a base language are kept as distinct corpora on the shared mesh edge. Apache-2.0. Domain 'mixed': WMT24++ extends WMT24's four-domain general test set — news, social (→conv), speech (→subtitles), literary; the canary/QC rows are dropped. domainDistribution is an approximate equal-quarters split.

datasets.name: WMT2025 General MT — blind test set ces→ukr
datasets.notes: WMT2025 General MT blind test set, fetched on demand via sacreBLEU (`sacrebleu -t wmt25 -l <pair> --echo src,ref`; pinned sacreBLEU 2.6.0). One of the field's canonical HELD-OUT blind sets — the clean tier that complements our public dev splits. Covers several genres (news, social, speech, literary). Scored against the PRIMARY reference (ref[0]); each sacreBLEU langpair is a distinct directed corpus (en-de → eng→deu, de-en → deu→eng). Domain 'mixed' with an APPROXIMATE domainDistribution (the General MT task spans genres; exact per-segment proportions are not published).
datasets.quarantine_reason: WMT25 is not bundled in sacreBLEU 2.6.0; pairs are PROVISIONAL (the WMT24 continuation set, unpinned). Catalogue-only until a later sacreBLEU ships wmt25 — then re-run build_wmt_general_cards.py to pin real pairs + drop this flag.
